articles.title: India’s AI moment more about deployment than discovery
articles.summary: For three decades, India was the world’s back office. During the next three decades, it may become the world’s AI workshop. That possibility lies behind one of the most consequential questions facing India’s economy. Artificial intelligence threatens the very industry that helped transform India into a global technology powerhouse.
